note: F04: brms wiener on tier_f's response times rt (above 0.35; 0.4092 at the least) with decisions dec (1 upper, 0 lower boundary): rt | dec(dec) ~ x + (1 | g); mu is the drift (identity link); bs, the boundary separation (log); ndt, the non-decision time, declared real<lower=0, upper=min_Y> with min_Y = min(Y) computed in transformed data (not in standata; probed as other), so every rt exceeds every ndt the points can take; bias, the relative starting point in (0, 1) (probed as other). Priors bs gamma(1, 1) (brms's default), ndt normal(0, 0.3), to which brms's lprior adds - log_diff_exp(normal_lcdf(min_Y | 0, 0.3), normal_lcdf(0 | 0, 0.3)) (brms's default is uniform(0, min_Y)), bias beta(2, 2) (lprior checked on the frozen points). Density Stan's wiener_lpdf(rt | bs, ndt, bias, mu) for dec = 1 and wiener_lpdf(rt | bs, ndt, 1 - bias, -mu) for dec = 0; standata dec. epred is brms's ndt - bias / mu + bs / mu (exp(-2 mu bias) - 1) / (exp(-2 mu bs) - 1) (checked), which puts the relative bias where the absolute starting point bs * bias belongs (the mean response time only when bs = 1); log_lik, loo and posterior_predict need RWiener, not installed (Please install the 'RWiener' package.), so Tier F has no wiener post case
